analysis_construction.quality_aggregation: median of each bird's previously archived eligible paired-source individual-day HDOP, matched GPS/baro height correlation, absolute centered height mismatch and number of paired fixes; do not select/drop birds by quality
analysis_construction.score: Original fixed per-bird D1 GPS MSL own-vs-other per-day balanced log-score gain
analysis_construction.association: Spearman rank correlation between each preexisting bird-level median-quality proxy and original fixed bird-level gain; p-values are unadjusted, descriptive, not mechanism tests
analysis_construction.measurement_quality_coverage: source paired HDOP and satellite count originated from same tag GPS fix, not an independent sensor calibration

descriptive_correlations.predictor: median within-day GPS–barometric centered absolute height mismatch (m)
median paired native GPS records per bird-day
number of bird-days with paired measurements

interpretation.limited_support: The original per-bird GPS identity gain does not show a strong simple monotonic correlation with the source's bird-median HDOP or GPS–baro magnitude difference in this small 27-bird descriptive dataset.
cannot_conclude: No sensor artifact exists; quality proxies are imprecise summaries, GPS/barometric estimates may share calibration and terrain/roost contexts.
No causal influence of HDOP/satellite number has been controlled; this is an unadjusted exploratory association.
Statistical independence of the 5854 bird-days; the inferential unit is 27 birds only.
